text: {"assertions":["Data loss in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt was discovered on the staging read replica during March 2026.","The root cause was a missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at).","The issue manifested as a local row missing after the next app launch.","The fix involved adding a composite index and backfilling data in batches via PR #5466 on branch fix/data-loss-1.","The bug could be reproduced by force-stopping the app with unsynced edits.","After the fix was deployed, the error rate decreased from 6.5% to under 0.01%.","The issue was located in the mobile sync side of OfflineCache.kt, continuing earlier data loss investigation work."]}
